followup_reviews.Research finding: Recovered Order 173 states 23:59 on March 15 for entry/exit of passenger vehicles, whereas a public announcement says 00:00 that date. Add the operative text and clock discrepancy without changing the calendar-day dates.

followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept ten targeted findings with the Albanian legal-clock qualification, police-attributed Morine endpoint and unresolved sequence, and the Benapole ordinary-passenger onset correction. The stopped bus’s 11 February passengers crossed on foot; the passenger phase is dated 12–13 February. Retain the explicit 13 February resumption date at calendar-day precision despite the documented inconsistent weekday; do not claim 24 elapsed hours, reliable passenger counts or stable emergency access. Formula-target suggestions become recalculation expectations. This is not a full-record audit of these ten parents.
